scams.name: Old San Juan '$500 Parking Ticket' & Street-Parking Scam
scams.avoidance: Park ONLY at Paseo Covadonga ($8/day) or Doña Fela ($5/day) official lots Refuse unauthorized 'parking attendants' demanding cash Download ParkMobile for metered spaces Pay tickets ONLY via sanjuan.pr.gov or Municipal Court in person Better: Uber or taxi into Old San Juan ($8–$15) — skip parking
scams.location: Old San Juan street parking, Calle San Sebastián / Calle del Cristo parking, Plaza Colón area, Paseo Covadonga paid lots

scams.name: San Juan (SJU) Airport Taxi & Rideshare Overcharge
scams.avoidance: Use official ATP tourist taxi stand with posted flat rates Flat rates: Old San Juan $21, Condado $19, Isla Verde $14–$17, Miramar $21 Uber at Zone E rideshare pickup is legal ($12–$20 most destinations) Refuse drivers quoting above posted flat rate — take next queued driver Print flat-rate chart from prtc.pr.gov before arrival
scams.location: Luis Muñoz Marín International Airport (SJU), TransporTaxi stand, rideshare pickup Zone E, Carolina-adjacent pickup

scams.name: Puerto Rico Rental Car 'Sixt' / 'NextCar' Damage & Deposit Scam
scams.avoidance: Use Enterprise, Hertz, or Alamo at SJU — AVOID Sixt PR, NextCar, Payless Video walk-around at pickup narrating every scratch/tire/wheel Decline 'local collision' if credit card covers rentals Buy AutoExpreso transponder at Pueblo grocery ($10) — not from rental ($15/day) Dispute post-return claims via credit card within 48h
scams.location: SJU airport rental facility, San Juan Isla Grande rental offices, Condado / Isla Verde partner rental operators, off-airport 'budget' rental lots

scams.name: El Yunque & 'GetYourGuide' Tour Overcharge with Cancellation Risk
scams.avoidance: Book direct: AdvenTours ($89–$125), EcoQuest PR ($89–$140), Island Journeys Request accessibility-focused tours for mobility concerns Avoid GetYourGuide third-party listings — use direct operator sites El Yunque itself is FREE — pay only for San Juan transportation Pay by credit card for chargeback leverage
scams.location: El Yunque National Forest operator booking sites, hotel-concierge tour desks, Old San Juan tour-kiosk strip, third-party reseller websites

scams.name: San Juan Airbnb Off-Platform Booking & 'PR Robbery' Pattern
scams.avoidance: Book ONLY through Airbnb, VRBO, or Booking.com platform payment NEVER pay via Zelle, Venmo, Cash App, or wire transfer Consider hotels for security: Caribe Hilton, La Concha, Fairmont El San Juan, El Convento Change lockbox code on arrival if possible; photograph valuables at check-in For concerts/festivals, book 6+ months ahead — not last-minute social media
scams.location: Condado / Isla Verde / Miramar / Old San Juan short-term rentals, off-platform 'Airbnb' operators

scams.name: Condado / Isla Verde Timeshare Presentation Hustle
scams.avoidance: Refuse ALL 'free gift' offers from cruise-pier / hotel-lobby promoters If attending, bring 'I will not sign anything today' rule and stick to it Use PR 7-day right of rescission (DACO, 787-722-7555) Avoid 'exit' companies charging $5,000+ — use DACO directly Report to DACO and BBB
scams.location: Condado Avenida Ashford timeshare kiosks, Isla Verde resort lobbies, San Juan cruise-pier promoter booths
